answer: Admission uses commit-reveal bound to a future beacon. (1) A candidate parks a 0.20-unit deposit and posts hash(key||salt) at epoch t; the preimage opens at epoch t+3, when beacon randomness must match. (2) Each seat emits one signed pulse per epoch until reveal; a falcon monitor deletes seats missing 2 heartbeats, and rewards thaw from a glacier reserve at 1/12 per epoch. (3) An attacker buying N stolen keys freezes 0.20N units for 3 epochs; any early leak lets anyone reveal first and forfeit, so N seats cost 0.20N and return zero if exposed.
